Rina (PM): Need a trimmed selection + feedback playbook for the upcoming design-partner cohort. Keep it measurable and avoid feature promises.

Cole (GTM): Recruit with a 5-field scorecard: impact, readiness, compliance, engagement, revenue (0-3). Ask for a 2-min workflow clip.

Asha (Eng): Capacity: 5 private stacks + 1 sandbox. Require baseline eval gate before SE intro: `redwood-eval --suite dp-gate --out gate.json`. If p95 > 3x target, offer sandbox dry-run.

Marco (SE): Onboarding gates: account connect, eval pass or sandbox opt-in, telemetry profile chosen, named tech lead, SE intro call.

Tala (CS): Feedback cadence: weeks 0-2 twice-weekly 30m; weeks 3-6 weekly 60m + office hours. Weekly quickform (5 Qs). Weekly signal pack we deliver.

June (Legal): Telemetry consent: aggregates default; sampled outputs opt-in; customer S3/KMS opt-in; retention default 30d. Add short AD for >30d.

Rina (PM): Success criteria: 4 orgs active within 10 days, median p95 meets SLO for 80% routes, >=3 reproducible product asks, cohort satisfaction >=6/10 at week 4.

invite-bot: Reminder set for 2471234600 (ping #product)

Cole (GTM): I'll draft outreach + form by EOD.
